the first that sends work back ends the pass, and the next answer is checked again.

g.text: Before a sub-agent's work is taken in (apart from the end gate):
only the tests it wrote or changed, in its copy - each part's
test command narrowed to them. Your own command runs them; a
guess only at Full auto - else the card waits for Run the test,
and while you are away it never runs. None written: no test before.

g.text: Nothing passes - in a copy: Not taken in,
Take in anyway / Fix it (your answer);
in the project: Still failing…, Fix it.
A check by kind of work failing after
A turn that changes nothing after a
failing one: Still failing as last
In a recipe: its own test-and-fix
